name: 🌱 Magic Garden Tycoon
description: Buy seeds, grow magical plants and sell your harvest to become the richest gardener! Plants keep growing while you are offline. Catch Rain, Thunderstorms, Golden Hours and moonlit Nights for Wet, Shocked, Moonlit, Golden and Rainbow fruits worth up to 50x. Complete daily quests, spin the free Lucky Wheel, level up, unlock titles, fill your Plant Index, adopt pets and decorate your garden. Rebirth for huge multipliers, grow the Mythic Crystal Lotus and climb the Top Gardeners board! Play with friends for +10% each.
